research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Matrubials is researching and developing milk-derived peptide compounds and compositions with antimicrobial activity, as described in 'Mammalian milk-derived peptides with antimicrobial activity.' These compounds and compositions are intended as alternatives to existing antibiotic and antimicrobial agents, focusing on antibacterial therapeutics for infectious diseases. The company's R&D centers on harnessing mammalian milk peptides for antimicrobial applications.

overview_description.description: Matrubials is developing novel antibacterial therapeutics to address non-selectivity and emerging antimicrobial resistance. They provide safe solutions that can reduce the healthcare and economic burden resulting from bacterial infections and concomitant clinical complications. That develops the anti-pathogenic molecules from milk into therapeutics geared towards all-age diseases.
